DELETE /api/v1/tasks/{task_id}.request: empty JSON object or empty body

GET /api/v1/attempts/{attempt_id}/events.pagination: Query: after >= -1 and limit 1..500; next page starts after next_after

GET /api/v1/automations.pagination: Query: limit 1..200 and opaque cursor; stable updated-at/ID ordering

GET /api/v1/automations/{automation_id}/.pagination: Query: limit 1..200 and opaque cursor; stable created-at/ID ordering

GET /api/v1/metrics/summary.pagination: Query: window is 24h, 7d, 30d, or all; default 7d

GET /api/v1/tasks.pagination: Query: limit 1..200 and opaque cursor; stable created-at/ID ordering

GET /api/v1/workflows.pagination: Query: title, enabled, limit 1..200, opaque cursor; stable updated-at/ID ordering

POST /api/v1/executions/{execution_id}/r.request: empty JSON object or empty body

POST /api/v1/tasks/{task_id}/cancel.request: empty JSON object or empty body

POST /api/v1/workers/{worker_id}/claims.response: 200 Claim JSON or 204 with no body

PUT /api/v1/workers/{worker_id}.request: WorkerRegistration JSON; legacy codex_version is accepted only without runtime fields
PUT /api/v1/workers/{worker_id}.response: 200 Worker JSON; legacy requests receive LegacyWorkerResponse JSON
